authorization.scope: bounded public Federal Register and GovInfo research export for EPA-HQ-OW-2022-0114 through the 2024-06-11 correction
authorization.basis: official U.S. Government public records; source terms and embedded-material exceptions remain binding

research_question: Can a frozen proposed-rule, final-rule, and correction dossier support a distinct, deterministic 64K/128K claim-source-revision world without padding or duplicate views?
constraints: official GovInfo PDF bytes are authoritative; FederalRegister.gov metadata is discovery and relation evidence only
proposal, final, and correction are counted once each; no HTML, XML, PDF, or text rendering duplication
capacity is measured after page-level exact and 0.90 word-sequence near-duplicate collapse
official contact blocks and email or telephone strings are excluded from normalized capacity
no docket comments, confidential business information, incorporated third-party standards, padding, cloning, or label-only world construction
no candidate generation or promotion before adapter, span-bound oracle, counterfactual, and unchanged historical gates are implemented
